sources.title: Marvel Tokon DLC Roadmap Reveals First Look at Jane Foster Thor, Venom and Jubilee Coming in 2027
sources.text: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls will continue its Year 1 DLC roadmap with Thor (Jane Foster) this winter, with two more characters coming in 2027. Developer Arc System Works confirmed the lineup alongside Evo France 2026. The Jane Foster version of Asgard's God of Thunder is now officially set to follow Phoenix Cyclops after he releases November 2, 2026, with today's announcement coming with both a sneak peek at her Marvel Tokon model in Odin's Vault on Asgard. The clip doesn't show too much, only teasing that we'll probably see Jane fight off Loki while wielding Mjolnir when a proper gameplay trailer premieres at a later date. Arc System Works said she's scheduled to launch in Marvel Tokon "winter 2027," so expect to see her arrival sometime before March of next year. Despite some concerns from players that poor sales could jeopardize the Marvel fighting game's future, at least two more characters will arrive in spring and summer 2027, too. Yes, Spider-Man anti-hero and Symbiote menace Venom will finally join the roster in spring 2027. X-Men firecracker Jubilee will then follow in the summer of that year. While Cyclops and Thor are entering the fray as relatively lesser-known versions of themselves, Venom and Jubilee appear to be mostly straightforward. That means Marvel Tokon players will get to see them fight the rest of the tag-team fighting with and against the game's roster – which includes characters like Doctor Doom, Iron Man, Carnage, Magneto, and more – in Arc System Works' heightened style. Although the details surrounding each DLC release are unclear, the reveal trailer did at least confirm that Venom will also come with a stage based on the Symbiote home world of Klyntar. It's all part of the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass, which costs $34.99. A roadmap with some of the most beloved characters from Marvel history would usually be enough to have comic book and video game fans frothing at the mouth, but uncertainty surrounding the project might have some looking at the Evo announcement in a different light. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls launched to strong reviews (a 9/10 from IGN) in August, but at least on PC, players have struggled. Its Steam launch brought mixed reviews from fans who complained of widespread technical issues and PlayStation Network requirements. Even as the developers almost immediately promised to investigate the issues, it didn't take long for the backlash to swell to the point that famed fighting game community member Maximilian Dood wrote off playing the PC version altogether . It only took a few days for Arc System Works to push out a fix for most players' issues , but as Steam player numbers still struggle to break even 1,000 concurrent users (via SteamDB ), even the developers have admitted earning back trust will be "extremely challenging." While Marvel Tokon's presence on PlayStation 5 seemed to go over well, director Kazuto Sekine eventually went on to apologize for the PC launch . The developers clearly have a game plan for at least up until summer 2027. While we wait to see how characters like Thor, Venom, and Jubilee will punch and kick their way into Marvel Tokon, you can read about the characters dataminers were expecting to see first . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

sources.text: Arc System Works revealed three more DLC fighters coming to the game in 2027 Arc System Works and Sony Interactive Entertainment have unveiled the rest of the Year 1 DLC characters for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls at EVO France. The first one to arrive after Phoenix Cyclops is a surprising pick. Instead of adding Thor Odinson to the tag fighter's roster, the developers chose Jane Foster's Thor. The trailer that debuted Jane Foster's Thor as a fighter also revealed the full Year 1 DLC lineup. Phoenix Cyclops kicks things off on Nov. 2. Then, in 2027, we can expect Thor (Jane Foster) to launch in the Winter, Venom in the Spring, and X-Men character Jubilee in the Summer. It's a strong group of DLC characters that come from different corners of the Marvel universe. While we didn't see any gameplay featuring Jane Foster's Thor, the trailer does show her confronting Loki in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls ' Asgard stage. This won't be the first time Jane Foster's Thor has been playable in a video game, as she was one of Marvel's Avengers ' last post-launch characters in 2022. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has shown a willingness to subvert expectations with its roster picks, featuring Shuri's Black Panther rather than T'Challa's and the Phoenix Force-infused Cyclops rather than the regular version. Venom is a fairly mainstream pull, though, and he'll join the game alongside a new Klyntar stage. As a fan of X-Men: The Animated Series and X-Men '97 , I'm most hyped for Jubilee's addition. She's already a lot of fun in Marvel Rivals , and I can't wait to see how Arc System Works adapts her flashy powers for its gorgeous fighting game. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is available on PlayStation 5 and Windows PC. To access these DLC characters, you'll need to buy the $84.99 Digital Deluxe Edition or the base game plus the $34.99 Year 1 Character and Stage Pass.

sources.text: Thor (Jane Foster), Venom, and Jubilee join Phoenix Cyclops in Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls ‘ Year 1 DLC lineup. Explore the announced 2026–2027 release plans below. Who is in Marvel Tōkon’s Year 1 DLC roster? Phoenix, Cyclops, Thor (Jane Foster), Venom, and Jubilee. Arc System Works announced the new roster members on social media, using artwork by Marvel artist Peach Momoko. So far, only Phoenix Cyclops has an official release date. He will be available on November 2. Jane Foster’s Thor is slated to release next, with a promised winter 2027 release window. Venom follows, with a spring 2027 release window. Jubilee is slated to round out this first year of DLC content with a summer 2027 release window. In a recent PlayStation blog post , Arc System Works explains why Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls chose Phoenix Cyclops, featuring new visuals, Optic Blasts, and Dark Phoenix gameplay. Takeshi Yamanaka, the game’s producer, said that early in development, the team considered Cyclops part of the Unbreakable X-Men foursome. Yamanaka noted that because of Cyclops’ history in Marvel fighting games, they wanted to distinguish their version of the character from previous games. That led them to choose the Phoenix version of Cyclops, which in turn led to the difficult decision to make him a DLC character rather than a day-one roster member. During those discussions, our narrative team proposed the idea of using the Phoenix version of Cyclops. We felt this interpretation would allow us to create fresher visuals and a more exciting fighting style while offering something unexpected for players. As a result, we made the difficult decision to continue working on the character until we felt like we were adding something new to his fighting game legacy. As a result, we’re excited to now release Phoenix Cyclops as our first post-launch DLC character. Cyclops also has a more traditional costume as an alternative. RELATED: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Review—The Ultimate Marvel Fighter PlayStation also revealed that Jane Foster will portray Thor as the game’s second DLC character. The reveal came via a trailer featuring her Mjolnir and a scene in which Loki calls her an imposter. Check out the trailer embedded above. sources.title: DMZ — 5 Features to Get Excited for in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s New Mode
sources.text: Call of Duty’s upcoming DMZ mode sounds like it’s shaping up to be something special. Set on the new Hajin map and inspired by the events and locations from Modern Warfare 4 ’s Campaign, this open-world combat environment will challenge you to loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and extract before everything you’ve earned is lost. Recent intel drops on the official Call of Duty Blog have given us a much clearer picture of what awaits in Hajin when DMZ launches as part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 can gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 and all of DMZ starting Tuesday, October 20. The events within DMZ are set after the main MW4 Campaign, leaving a power vacuum in its wake. Now it’s up to you to identify a new, mysterious threat and dismantle its operations across the DMZ through various deployments. From scavenging for crafting materials and experimenting with new technology, to leveling up an Operator, the mode sounds like it offers plenty to look forward to. Here are five features to get excited for when you begin your deployment. The 3D Printer will be available back at the Forward Operating Base (FOB) between deployments and will serve as your primary crafting station to build equipment and upgrades for your loadout before you drop into Hajin. The Call of Duty Blog shares that , as you progress through the DMZ, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes to create more powerful equipment – as well as upgrades to the 3D Printer and even the Forward Operating Base itself. Recipes can also be found on deployments and, presuming you extract in one piece, you can then craft those items for your Operator back at the FOB. When focused on crafting new equipment, the two key things you’ll be looking for when looting on deployments will be Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients – these are the two types of main elements to craft all items. There are four basic Resources to find during a deployment: Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, and Metals, automatically broken down from looted items, into your Backpack and Stash. 3D Printer Ingredients are rarer materials found in specific areas of Hajin and are valuable as an ingredient to make a new Item. Examples include Binding Catalyst, Biomaterials, Detonators, and Control Units, to name a few. Once you have enough of these two types of materials, you can select how many copies of an item you want to craft at once, then choose where crafted items go: send completed items directly to your Stash for later or equip them directly to your Operator to quickly prepare for the next deployment. Having this flexibility in how you want to engage the enemy during your deployment can open a variety of experiences in DMZ and can make each deployment feel like it matters, even if you come back to the FOB with zero kills to your name – at least you’ve got handful of electronics or a comms module to make it worth your time. Extraction shooters are always more engaging when every deployment has a clear purpose. That’s not going to be problem with DMZ as it will offer three ways to deploy: Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, and Free Roam. Of those, Story Missions and Dynamic Operations are two that really stand out with their defined objectives and high-tier rewards. According to the Call of Duty Blog , Story Missions will feature narrative-led deployments that you can complete and replay, though some remain locked until prerequisites are met. Each entry provides briefing intel, required objectives, and rewards – usually high-value gear and DMZ Cash – along with options for a random mission and additional milestone rewards. Dynamic Operations, meanwhile, give squads multiple goals to pursue within the DMZ. After deploying, you choose an operation and complete its objectives to earn DMZ XP, Cash, and the ability to call in a Supply Drop filled with unpredictable loot. That extra payoff adds anticipation to every successful Op while making Dynamic Operations a promising source of both Cash and XP. Persistent Operators may be DMZ’s most exciting feature because they allow Hajin to leave a lasting mark on you. You’ll begin with two Operator slots, and unlock a third as you progress through DMZ levels. Each Operator then grows stronger by surviving deployments and earning DMZ XP. Each successful exfil levels up your Operator’s Dog Tags, and this is the key to gaining Trait Points for your Operator. You can invest those points across the Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist Trait Trees, creating a meaningful choice between specialization and flexibility: with a maximum of 18 points to earn, and a choice of over 60 Trait Points to augment your Operator, you can tailor each Operator to your skills and preferred role. For example, Warfighter Traits include Combat Resistance, Quick Fix, and Viper Sense; Scout Traits include improved Thermal Padding, UAV Upgrade, and Field Crafting; while Survivalist Traits include Faster and Free Revives, increased Consumable Duration, and many more. But here’s where it gets dicey: if an Operator fails to extract and becomes MIA, you must either recover them with DMZ Cash or dismiss them. Because recovery costs rise with Trait investment, bringing back a high-level Operator becomes increasingly expensive. Recovered Operators keep their Traits but lose their gear, putting real weight behind every deployment. The chase for loot is at the heart of every extraction shooter, and DMZ makes each haul matter beyond the current deployment. Returning to base with a pack full of supplies doesn’t just feel rewarding – it improves your chances of success the next time you enter Hajin. Once you drop into a deployment, looting should be a top priority. stories.summary: Earlier this year at MagicCon in Las Vegas, Wizards of the Coast revealed its in-universe sets for 2027, but that only covered three of the six planned sets. The other three are Universes Beyond — the card game's crossover brand — and now we know about another one, Darkhold Destiny, the new Marvel set.

sources.title: Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny Panel – Everything Announced
sources.text: Wizards of the Coast just announced Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny , its latest Marvel set in a New York Comic Con panel. This is the third Marvel collaboration for the card game, but where the first two were about presenting super heroes as they already exist in Marvel canon, Wizards of the Coast was able to cook up its own storyline for Darkhold Destiny. The set revolves around the likes of Doctor Strange, Thor and Ghost Rider, all trying to work against Hela and Dormammu invading the multiverse. It's a much better thematic fit for Magic: The Gathering, and the early cards have introduced new mechanics like Vengeance, which is like the Adventure mechanic introduced in Throne of Eldraine, but evil . Even though there was a lot of information in this panel, the set doesn't come out until April 8th next year, so there are still plenty of details that WotC is holding close to its chest. And, keep in mind that there are still two more Universes Beyond sets coming next year that we don't know anything about. 8:35 pm: And that's the show. Darkhold Destiny, looks like a cool set, but there's still a lot that Wizards didn't reveal. But it's a decent start! 8:33 pm: WotC announced a special promo or Doctor Doom, King of Latveria for Avengers Doomsday. you'll be able to grab it if you go see the movie at a Regal Cinemas on opening weekend "as long as supplies last". It's the face of the Dr. Doom commander deck, and it's done in the style of the MCU, so I expect it'll go fast. 8:31 pm: One more thing. There will be three Secret Lair drops inspired by Dr. Doom, just in time for the new Avengers movie. They're not revealing which cards are in the drop yet, but there is Dr. Doom art, and they told the crowd "you'll have to guess which reprint this is". I guess we'll wait. 8:26 pm: There are new Secret Lair, a countdown kit, a giant box with 30 cards. This thing is about to cost a lot of money. Most people will get it in nonfoil, but there will be a random chance that you'll get it in traditional foil, and an even more rare chance to get it in surge foil. I guess the Secret Lair booster packs didn't work, but we're at least getting to gamble on whether or not they're foil. The Secret Lair launches November 2nd. 8:22 pm: There will be two bundles, a regular bundle and an 'Arcanum' bundle. Both of these will have their own mechanically unique promo card. Hopefully that card doesn't get too expensive! There are also two scene boxes, also filled with mechanically unique cards. 8:19 pm: For the product suite, we have Booster Packs, Collector Boosters, Prerelease Pack and Draft Night (which also has a Collector Booster). There will also be four commander decks, Strange Academy (WUB), Gods of Asgard (RGW), Midnight Sons (WB) and Lords of Hel (BR). There will also be Collectors Editions for each deck that'll be completely decked out in surge foils. 8:16 pm: The basic lands take after the Adventures From the Forgotten Realms lands, with flavor text that tell the story. Unlike that D&D set, though, each Basic Land type has two variants, one before Hela and Dormammu's invasion and one after. They look awesome. 8:13 pm: One more card, Temple of Khonshu. It's a common black/white land and it enters tapped unless you control a Dimension. Dimension is some kind of new card type, and Wizards is not revealing it yet. I hope they're better than Battles. 8:10 pm: They brought Arcane back, which was a card subtype that hasn't really existed since the Kamigawa block in the 2000s. We got a black modal spell, and a red one "Rise From the Nether" that creates 3/1 creature tokens. Bring back Splice Onto Arcane. 8:08 pm: Hela's card looks awesome, it introduces a new keyword, Vengeance, which is basically just an Adventure that you cast when the card is in the graveyard. So, if Hela is your commander, you can send her to the graveyard when she dies, then put her in the command zone when you cast from the graveyard, and make a little loop. 8:05 pm: They introduced Magik as a dual faced card. sources.text: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through. Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community. "A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room. "Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil." You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues. "This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this." "​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team." There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. sources.title: Star Citizen Single-Player Spinoff Squadron 42 Reemerges With Flashy New Trailer, Steam Wishlists, and Cast Confirmation
sources.text: Star Citizen developer Cloud Imperium Games has pulled back the curtain on single-player spinoff Squadron 42 with a new cinematic trailer, the launch of Steam wishlists, and a full cast reveal. Squadron 42 is the story-driven off-shoot of space sim Star Citizen, which Cloud Imperium Games has worked on for the last 12 years. Its 12-year development is led by Chris Roberts, creator of the Wing Commander series. Indeed, Squadron 42 is a spiritual successor to Wing Commander, and like the Wing Commander games, Squadron 42 features a string of Hollywood stars, such as Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Ben Mendelsohn, and Henry Cavill. The game fuses space combat, first-person shooter action, and a character-driven narrative supported by full performance capture. CIG said the performances are woven directly into gameplay, so you won’t just see those famous actors within cinematics. And here’s what to expect from the structure of the game: The trailer shows a decent amount of gameplay, including first-person sections, some of which involve platforming and puzzle solving, ship customization, off duty activities, a hacking mini-game, and a glimpse at narrative choices. Ian Duncan, best known for playing Todd Todmore on BBC comedy Broken News, is the male player character, and prolific video game actor Alix Wilton Regan (Samantha Traynor in Mass Effect 3, the female Inquisitor in Dragon Age: Inquisition, Aya in Assassin's Creed Origins, and Lara Croft in the upcoming Tomb Raider games) plays the female player character. In August, CIG delayed Squadron 42 to Q2 2027 , with Roberts insisting it wouldn’t get the attention it deserves if it came out at the end of 2026 because of November’s GTA 6. "At CitizenCon 2024, we announced we would ship in 2026. Our plan was to release in Q4 around IAE," Roberts said at the time. "But much like the rest of the industry there is no way I want to launch my spiritual successor to Wing Commander, a game that has had 12 years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it (we started Squadron 42 development in 2014 as 2013 was opening studios, hiring people and getting the Hangar module out for Star Citizen) launching into the attention buzz saw of GTA 6. While GTA 6 isn’t launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage." The delay announcement came hot on the heels of a disastrous Star Citizen developer livestream that went radically off the rails . After early access players complained of bugs and issues with a new update to the game, CIG held a stream to show the "intended" version of the experience, only to be met with the same issues, if not worse. It led to passive-aggressive comments between the developers themselves and an uncomfortable tension in the air. Star Citizen crossed the $1 billion raised barrier in May — a significant milestone that came shortly after a $5,000 virtual spaceship you couldn’t actually fly in-game went on sale. It’s since raised a further $50 million. Star Citizen is considered one of the most controversial projects in all video games. Over the 14 years since its crowdfunding drive began, Star Citizen has been called many things, including a scam by those who wonder whether it will ever properly launch. Its virtual ships, some of which cost thousands of dollars, are often the focus of criticism. But its loyal fanbase insist it's one of the most compelling space sims around, and continue to pump millions of dollars into the project via ship sales. Star Citizen itself remains without a release window. Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

stories.title: Developer Goes Into Debt Spending $1,000 A Day To Keep Steam Demo For AI-Fueled Driving Sim Going
stories.summary: Hoping to launch next year, Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is prematurely sending its creators into the red over exhaustive token use

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Developer Goes Into Debt Spending $1,000 A Day To Keep Steam Demo For AI-Fueled Driving Sim Going
sources.text: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is an upcoming DMV simulator where players, riding passenger, instruct a chaotic young student to pass their exam. Developers Easy Fox are embracing AI for the project, the titular sister a live chat bot that the player is instructing. Beyond contention for the tech, Easy Fox are finding that the mere demo for the game is proving to be problematic, as accounting for the token usage is forcing them into debt . “Over the past month, the number of demo players has grown more than twentyfold,” reads the Steam pageâs latest update . “Thank you so much for giving our game far more attention than we ever expected. This growth has also increased our operating costs considerably.” As the update explains, the game originally patched players through to a chat bot operating on Googleâs Gemini. With no cost barrier between them and the curious, players of the demo were triggering limit-use errors, Google informing Easy Fox that thereâs no easy way out. Switching to the competing OpenAI model, while hoping to finding a fix with Gemini, is proving to be the least of their problems. Easy Fox says the surge of players has forced them to take out a bank loan to keep the demo operating. Maintaining the demo is apparently costing them more than $1,000 a day, which they admit they will have to factor into pricing the final product. While a number of game developers have flocked to AI to create in-game assets and code on the back-end, Teach My Little Sister is a more unique case. Leveraging an agent for sustained real-time gameplay, the game has found an expensive way to recreate what Lifeline and Hey You, Pikachu! accomplished over 20 years ago. “We want to continue operating the demo and would love for more people to enjoy it,” writes Easy Fox. “However, we are a small team of four, and financial pressure may mean we have to close the demo earlier than expected before the full release. We have not made that decision at this time.” The update also addresses complaints that, even in a game based around calamity, the AI fueled sister is not following instructions as desired. While a microcosm of it, the financial strain is an amusing illustration of one of AIâs biggest white elephant. That is, no oneâs sure how to make money off of it. While proliferating in short video content, horrifying fast food posters and visual assets devs “meant to take out,” the firms themselves are running purely on investments, not generating profit. The amount of resources needed to keep these computers burning continually outweighs what the public is otherwise willing to spend to see SpongeBob murder Shrek . Over the last year, AI firms have been forced to adjust, adding new premiums to their service, the so-called “tokenpocalypse.” With the global economy now held hostage by the industry, the burdens of the tech continue to put people on edge. sources.title: The developer of an AI-powered driving instruction simulator is spending $1,000 per month just to keep its demo running
sources.text: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive centres around a costly chatbot. One of the many ways AI will (supposedly) revolutionise the games industry in facilitating highly reactive NPCs via LLM-powered chatbots. Yet so far, only a handful of games like Where Winds Meet have attempted to implement the tech, and the results have been less than spectacular. But there might also be another reason why relatively few games feature LLM-powered NPCs, which is that powering such chatbots can be costly, as recently demonstrated by the developers of an upcoming driving instructor simulator As reported by FRVR (via Kotaku ) Teach My Little Sister How To Drive is a comic simulation game in which you coach your virtual sibling on driving technique from the comfort of the passenger seat. The twist is that behind your sister's dinner-plate eyes is an LLM chatbot (currently powered by an OpenAI model, though the developers intend to use Gemini for the final release) In the role of instructor, players can both converse with the chatbot and issue vocal instructions such as "turn left here", to which the bot will respond accordingly. At least, that's the theory. Developer Easy Fox released a demo for Teach My Little Sister How To Drive back in February, but in the past month the game has seen a surge in players, which has had an interesting knock-on effect for the demo. "The number of demo players has grown more than twentyfold," Easy Fox explained in a Steam post , adding. "This growth has also increased our operating costs considerably." Easy Fox goes on to explain that it is "spending over $1,000 per day on AI services for the demo", as players burn through tokens prompting the LLM by proxy. Easy Fox claims that figure "isn't because each player is particularly expensive to support", but rather that "so many people are playing." As a result of this, Easy Fox has "taken out a bank loan to help keep the demo running". Yet even this may not be sufficient to support the demo long term. "Financial pressure may mean we have to close the demo earlier than expected before the full release," Easy Fox says, though the studio stresses it has "not made that decision at this time". According to FRVR, that twentyfold increase in players amounts to 450 concurrent. While the overall player numbers will be higher than that, it isn't an enormous figure, and it makes me wonder how financially viable the game will be when it is released. Easy Fox says it will "account for expected AI usage in the game's price". But it also says that players "will not be charged separately for their individual AI token usage after purchasing the game". That might work in the short term, but surely those token costs are going to pile up over time. It's also worth noting that AI token costs are highly unpredictable , with even large companies like Microsoft and Uber struggling to accurately predict the cost and burn rate of their own internal token use. In its Steam post, Easy Fox says it's looking into options like introducing local AI models for players with "sufficiently capable GPUs". But that's only going to be a fraction of the player-base. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. All of this is aside from whether an AI-powered driving instruction game is a good idea. Personally, I think the fact that it revolves specifically around chatting with another character makes this a more sensible application than in Where Winds Meet, where the chatbots don't factor into the game design in any meaningful way. It's much more reminiscent of early chatbot-based social sim Façade . But the very fact it reminds me of Façade makes me wonder whether the game needs a premium LLM connected to it to achieve its goal. Easy Fox states that current design problems being addressed include "dialogue that feels too artificial and breaks immersion" and "commands being carried out incorrectly, such as turning right when asked to turn left." All of which seems like it could be solved with a good voice actor and a sufficiently rich dialogue system. Easy Fox plans to release the full game in January next year, so we'll find out exactly how the finances stack up then. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Rick has been fascinated by PC gaming since he was seven years old, when he used to sneak into his dad's home office for covert sessions of Doom. stories.title: Entenda os 5 diferentes finais de Silent Hill: Townfall
stories.summary: O final de Townfall é determinado por algumas ações ao longo do jogo

sources.name: Voxel
sources.title: Entenda os 5 diferentes finais de Silent Hill: Townfall
sources.text: Silent Hill: Townfall , o novo spin-off desenvolvido pela Screen Burnem parceria com a Konami, chega para expandir o universo da franquia em um cenário inédito . Desta vez, estamos na isolada ilha escocesa de St. Amelia, em 1996. O protagonista, Simon Ordell, é convocado de volta à cidade para “colocar as coisas em ordem”, mas encontra apenas uma névoa densa cobrindo ruas aparentemente abandonadas. Apesar de não se passar na cidade famosa da franquia, o tipo de contexto é basicamente o mesmo. Seguindo a tradição de jogos da série, Townfall não conta com um final único. Em vez disso, as ações do jogador ao longo da campanha determinam qual desfecho a história vai tomar. Para te ajudar a entender melhor o conceito, listamos os todos os finais de Silent Hill: Townfall e te contamos o que é necessário para conseguir cada um deles. Confira! Como revelado previamente pelos desenvolvedores, o jogo conta com 5 finais diferentes, sendo que 2 são secretos. Assim como em jogos anteriores da série, as decisões tomadas pelo jogador ao longo da aventura é que definem o desfecho, até para que o final pareça coerente com a experiência vivida durante a partida. Não existe uma escolha explícita em algum momento marcante do enredo que define isso, já que o final é determinado por alguns elementos diferentes. O sistema acompanha o comportamento do jogador durante toda a partida, incluindo o quanto ele explora e investiga St. Amelia e o quão agressivo ele é ao ser confrontado por inimigos, em contraste com evitar ou fugir dos combates. Essa abordagem lembra diretamente o clássico Silent Hill 2 , em que o final também refletia padrões de comportamento e não escolhas de diálogo, por exemplo. Dos 5 desfechos possíveis , 3 estão disponíveis já na primeira vez que você zera a campanha , sem necessidade de repetir o jogo. Já os outros 2 finais secretos exigem uma segunda campanha jogada no modo New Game Plus. Esses 3 finais “normais” são chamados de Justice, Forever e Abandoned e são considerados os desfechos principais da trama de Simon. Eles são determinados exclusivamente pela relação entre quantos inimigos o jogador elimina durante a partida e quantas descobertas, como pistas e documentos, ele coleta ao longo do caminho. O tempo de jogo ou uso de itens de cura não influencia nesse resultado. Também é bom mencionar que que esse equilíbrio entre mortes e descobertas afeta apenas a cena final antes dos créditos, sem alterar outras cenas ou a progressão da história ao longo da campanha. Até por isso, você é que tem lembrar de como quer abordar o jogo para conseguir o final desejado. Conforme mencionamos, além dos 3 finais principais, o jogo reserva 2 desfechos extras classificados como secretos , chamados de Dog e Sci-fi. Quem é fã veterano da franquia Silent Hill sabe que esses são finais absolutamente clássicos e colocados no jogo apenas como uma brincadeira extra para o jogador se divertir. Por serem uma piada, é necessário zerar o game uma vez para conseguir um final sério e, então, zerá-lo uma segunda vez no New Game Plus para ter acesso aos desfechos secretos. Como explicado acima, o sistema de finais de Townfall não depende de escolhas de diálogo ou momentos de decisão específicos, mas sim do comportamentos do jogador ao longo de toda a campanha. Para facilitar, nós listamos o que é necessário para cada um. O final Justice é considerado por muitos como o desfecho “bom” da história. Ele é obtido ao final de uma campanha em que o número de descobertas, na forma de pistas e documentos coletados, é significativamente maior do que o número de inimigos eliminados. A boa notícia é que é possível ter dezenas de eliminações e ainda assim alcançar esse final, até porque alguns confrontos ao longo da aventura são praticamente inevitáveis. Por isso, só tente ter certeza de que a quantidade de descobertas seja bem superior. O final Forever é tratado como o desfecho “normal” do jogo. Ele surge quando a quantidade de descobertas é apenas ligeiramente maior do que a quantidade de eliminações ao término da campanha. Diferente do Justice, aqui a margem entre pistas coletadas e inimigos mortos é bem mais estreita, exigindo um equilíbrio mais cuidadoso por parte do jogador ao longo da aventura. Já o Abandoned é considerado o final “ruim” da história. Ele ocorre sempre que o número de inimigos eliminados supera o número de descobertas feitas até o fim do jogo. Para quem opta por um estilo de jogo mais agressivo, ignorando documentos e pistas em favor do combate direto, esse desfecho é praticamente garantido. O final “Dog” é um dos desfechos secretos, exclusivos do New Game Plus. Ele é desbloqueado ao encontrar três moedas especiais espalhadas por diferentes áreas da cidade durante a nova campanha. Com as moedas em mãos, você precisa depositá-las em cofres em formato de cachorro, ligados a uma instituição de cães-guia presente no cenário do jogo. Completar essa sequência de itens substitui o final principal que o jogador obteria normalmente. O Sci-fi é o segundo final secreto, também restrito ao New Game Plus. Para obtê-lo, é necessário interagir com três livros específicos escondidos em diferentes pontos da campanha, resolver um quebra-cabeça de porta usando um código, e por fim utilizar um item especial obtido nesse processo em um painel eletrônico próximo ao fim da aventura. Diferente dos demais finais, o Sci-fi é acionado antes da batalha final, pulando completamente esse confronto e levando direto ao desfecho. Se não quiser spoilers sobre os finais de Silent Hill: Townfall, é melhor pular essa parte do nosso guia! No final “Justice”, Simon consegue encarar os traumas do seu passado de frente, encontrando uma resolução pacífica e libertadora para a sua culpa. No final “Forever”, o protagonista se recusa a aceitar os fatos totalmente e decide permanecer preso na névoa e nas memórias da ilha. No final Abandoned, dominado pela raiva e violência, Simon sucumbe totalmente ao pesadelo e se torna parte do ciclo de sofrimento do loc

sources.text: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is back with another video, this time with a naked Lucia taking a parachute jump off a rooftop. The five-minute clip was posted on ResetEra a few days after CyberLeek's 25-minute video of Jason , and a day after the leaker threatened to release a full playable build . Note: there are some mild spoilers pertaining to what you might do in GTA 6 below. The video - which I'm afraid I'm not going to post here - reportedly opens with CyberLeek driving through Vice City in a black-and-white car, before Lucia gets out in nowt but her birthday suit. As with Jason, nobody reacts to her, and as we noted last time, whoever is playing seems to have access to a dev menu, which means a naked Lucia could be a debug feature rather than something you'll be able to do in the open world. Lucia then heads up some stairs to an ATM, where she beats up a passer-by and takes their money. The machine shows a $15,000 limit and a Buckme logo (thanks, TheGamer ). She goes into a nearby building, where a construction worker asks if she's with the guy on the roof, and takes the elevator after a short exchange. Following a phone call, she makes her way to the roof and is handed a parachute before jumping off. CyberLeek isn't a natural at that part of the game. The first jump drifts well off course and ends in a crash into a building, while the second gets closer to the target but sails past the landing point. The video also includes an in-game ad for Buckme. CyberLeek has said they'll release the full build if their cryptocurrency coin reaches a market cap of $30 million . Rockstar has previously issued statements regarding the leaker, noting that the leaks are "heartbreaking" and that "this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time". Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, has been hunting for the person behind the leaks, and has tried to subpoena Discord for information pertaining to the leaker's identity. sources.text: Cyberleek is promising GTA 6 fans nude Lucia gameplay in 4K Cyberleek, the notorious Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who has spent the last couple of months posting unauthorized gameplay online, is now threatening to release the game's development build . There's a catch: The leaker says he'll only provide a playable build of the game if viewers raise Cyberleek's meme coin market cap to an incredible $30 million. To reach that number, Cyberleek is tempting GTA 6 fans with videos of Lucia Caminos, the game's co-protagonist, fully nude. Cyberleek is also adding fuel to the fire by appealing to gamers who dislike the business practices of Rockstar's parent company , Take-Two. Unlike most major games, GTA 6 won't be released on physical discs — boxes will only hold a download code. The fandom has also taken umbrage with Take-Two's decision to gate impressive cosmetics behind a $100 special edition . While cosmetics don't impact the core gameplay, many fans approach GTA 6 as a role-playing game where a character's looks are pivotal. CYBERLEEK hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out — full story mode, played to the end, credits and all. Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick. Yes. The leaker incentivized donations by teasing milestones that determined how much Lucia would be clothed. If the market cap reached $2 million, Lucia would be shown in a bikini. At $3 million, the gameplay would show Lucia topless. A fully nude Lucia was tied to a $4 million market cap, which Cyberleek reached in no time. The meme coin's market cap has grown by 275% according to tracking websites. Clips and GIFs of nude Lucia are all over social media, though much of this media gets pulled as quickly as it is shared. The revealing new clip depicts Lucia Caminos as a model with braided hair from the start of the game, when she is apparently imprisoned for an unknown crime. In it, Lucia performs a backflip skydiving stunt, much like the one visible during Rockstar's second official trailer. The stunt ends with Cyberleek crashing Lucia into a building , leading to a "Wasted" death screen. Lucia also antagonizes NPCs who readily fight her back yet don't seem to react to the character's nudity. That lack of interaction was also visible in a recent leaked video of co-protagonist Jason Duvall in the nude — which has made viewers wonder if GTA 6 will truly allow for such gameplay. If Cyberleek has access to a development build, the hacker may be forcing the game to generate playable naked characters. Recent previews say that GTA 6 does feature nudity, but camera angles are set to avoid full-frontal. Recent game age ratings also say that GTA 6 will depict sex, but we don't know how this will work or if that nudity will extend to the game at large. By posting gameplay of nude Lucia, Cyberleek is appealing to the so-called gooners who are already obsessed with the character. Such players have been begging Cyberleek to post Lucia bare since the leaks began back in August. The new video is exploding in communities like r/gta6unmoderated, where desperate players are posting thousands of comments asking how to watch it. Such communities, which were known to share AI-generated videos of Lucia naked prior to the leak , are rife with comments dissecting Lucia's appearance. Unfortunately, the chaos raises an uncomfortable question of how such leaks will impact the real-world actress who is reportedly Lucia's model. The current $Cyberleek market cap is somewhere in the $5 million range, which is close to the $6 million milestone that promised naked Lucia gameplay in 4K resolution. Given that players are currently complaining Lucia's private parts aren't in high definition, the proposed market cap is likely to be just a matter of time. There's been much debate over the provenance of Cyberleek's videos, and whether the leaker truly has a full build of the game . Skeptics noted that, by offering polls with pre-determined options, Cyberleek could just be posting clips of gameplay that was recorded ahead of the leaks. Recent leaks in which Cyberleek seemingly generates a tank out of thin air have challenged that assumption — it seems that the hacker might've had access to a playable build of the game at some point. The newest threat against Rockstar further raises questions about what Cyberleek can currently access within GTA 6 and how the brazen leaker has come this far without being caught .

sources.title: Godzilla Minus Zero trailer brings back the big guy in a tantalizing and terrifying trailer
sources.text: New preview for one of the best films of the year stomps onto screens The ground is shaking, and people are running in every direction, which can only mean the big, angry fella known as the King of Monsters has returned, as revealed in a brand-new trailer for the eagerly anticipated Godzilla Minus Zero. Director Takashi Yamazaki returns to the camera with an all-new chapter that picks up after Godzilla Minus One, as post-war Japan struggles to get back on its feet after Godzilla's initial attack, only to face a new foe: King Ghidorah. Naturally, Godzilla regenerates, proving this town isn't big enough for these two building-bashing monsters and that only a battle for supremacy can settle things. GamesRadar+ has already passed a verdict, and we think it's easily one of the best films of the year, and we're not the only ones. With a nearly perfect Rotten Tomatoes score , it's clear Yamazaki is delivering on his previous effort, and the cast is too. Returning to take on the giant beasties are Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Hidetaka Yoshioka, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Sakura Ando, and Miou Tanaka. Joining them in the chaos this time around are also Min Tanaka, Masami Nagasawa, and Jun Kunimura. The film also marks a first in Godzilla's history: the only R-rated Godzilla flick to date , ensuring severe casualties as the giant fire-breathing lizard takes on the triple threat of King Ghidorah. Speaking to the decision, Yamazaki assured that "There were certain scenes that, for me as a director, were so essential to the film. Censoring it or cutting it was just not an option for me." It was the right call, but we'll see how he handles things when Godzilla: Minus Zero arrives in theaters on November 6. To prep for what's in store, check out our full review. sources.text: A new threat emerges in the latest trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero Less than a day after the movie's New York Comic Con panel, a second Godzilla Minus Zero trailer was released. Like the previous trailer, it suggests that Godzilla isn't the only monster threat that humans will have to contend with in this highly anticipated sequel. The trailer begins with a doctor suggesting that Noriko had "no business surviving" the events of Godzilla Minus One before cutting to Koichi flying through a supernatural storm, lifting entire houses far up into the air. Cue a sizzle reel of people running from or discussing how they're scared of the impending threat, all culminating with a massive atomic breath attack from Godzilla. That said, Godzilla doesn't seem to be the only monster humans will face in this movie. The trailer's description alludes to "a new threat," and while it doesn't show another creature, it hints at one. Namely, while Godzilla's attacks have a blue hue in Godzilla Minus One and this trailer, we also see beams attacking civilians and destroying a bomb at certain points in the trailer that look more yellow or lightning-like. If you want to avoid spoilers for Godzilla Minus Zero before watching it in theaters, stop reading here! As Polygon's review and comments from the filmmakers at New York Comic Con confirm, Gidorah plays a major role in Godzilla Minus Zero. Ever since the three-headed monster debuted in 1964, it has been one of the Godzilla franchise's most recognizable characters and has faced off against Godzilla in many different movies. We last saw Gidorah in 2019's American-made Godzilla: King of the Monsters , so it'll be exciting to see how a Japanese filmmaker like Takashi Yamazaki reinterprets the character for his series' post-World War 2 setting. I absolutely adored the first movie, so that's more than enough of an enticing prospect to get me to see this movie in IMAX. Godzilla Minus Zero will come to theaters on Nov. 6.

You can always find this collection hub in the XBOX Store and on XBOX.com/IndieSelects. Halloween has never been just about scares. Sure, there’s plenty of room for heart-pounding frights, but it’s also a season that celebrates imagination, creativity, and stepping into worlds beyond the ordinary. This month, indie developers embraced that spirit in unforgettable ways. For October, the ID@XBOX team has curated six standout Indie Selects that invite you to discover mysterious realms, conquer new challenges, and uncover stories waiting to be told. From epic battles and eldritch horrors to cozy puzzles and island adventures, each game offers a richly crafted world filled with surprises around every corner. So, whether you’re seeking thrills, mystery, or a new adventure to get lost in, here are this month’s Indie Selects (in no particular order): Mortal Shell II is still unapologetically challenging, but combat feels faster and more aggressive this time around. The removal of the traditional stamina gauge means encounters aren’t simply about waiting for a bar to refill. You can stay in the fight, combining melee weapons, sidearms, abilities and brutal executions. It makes combat feel considerably more fluid than before. The world has grown too. Rather than simply pushing you down a predetermined path, Mortal Shell II encourages exploration across a compact, interconnected open world filled with hidden areas, dungeons, weapons, upgrades and, naturally, plenty of horrible things waiting to ruin your afternoon. What I particularly enjoy is that exploration feels connected to progression. Finding another Shell isn’t just another collectible checked off a list. It can completely change how you approach the game. Weapons offer extensive upgrade paths as well, giving you plenty of room to shape your own approach to combat. Mortal Shell II certainly isn’t interested in making life easy for you, but there’s something satisfying about gradually turning the tables. You go from cautiously approaching every new enemy to becoming the nightmare wandering through their world. If you enjoy dark fantasy, exploration, challenging combat and the satisfaction of mastering a game that initially seems determined to destroy you, Mortal Shell II is absolutely worth having on your radar. If you’ve ever wondered what it would be like to assemble your dream team of benders and settle legendary rivalries yourself , Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is ready to make that happen. This 2D tag-team fighter brings together iconic characters from “Avatar: The Last Airbender” and “The Legend of Korra,” combining elemental bending, flashy special moves, and fast-paced team combat into an experience that’s easy to jump into and rewarding to master. As a longtime fan of the Avatar universe, this game immediately grabbed my attention. There’s something incredibly satisfying about watching beloved characters leap from the screen into a fighting game that feels so true to the world they come from. From the first match, I found myself grinning at familiar abilities, character interactions, and bending styles brought to life in exciting new ways. What impressed me most is how distinct every fighter feels. Experimenting with different team combinations kept me coming back for “just one more match” as I discovered new strategies and synergies. Fans of games like Dragon Ball FighterZ , Marvel vs. Capcom , and Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid will recognize the thrill of building a team and learning how each character complements the others. There’s plenty to learn with its tag mechanics and assists, but the journey of improving feels rewarding and keeps every victory exciting. Whether you grew up with “Avatar: The Last Airbender,” fell in love with “The Legend of Korra,” or simply enjoy energetic team-based fighting games, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game captures the heart of the franchise while delivering a fun and action-packed experience that’s hard to put down. From the moment I started playing Mewgenics , I knew I was in for a wild ride. From Edmund McMillen, the developer behind The Binding of Isaac , Super Meat Boy , and The End is Nigh , Mewgenics is a roguelike tactical turn-based RPG presented in a unique and cartoonish macabre art style, filled with dark humor and clever references. Mewgenics offers a staggering amount of content that easily demands over a hundred hours of playtime, complete with deep strategy and a generational breeding system (yes, you breed mutant cats). The game hooks you right away with its chaotic setup, you’re managing a house full of mutated cats and sending them out on tactical, grid-based runs. Every item, skill, and attribute is randomized, meaning no two runs ever play out the same way. When your cats survive a brutal dungeon crawl, they bring back scars and mutations that you can pass down to future generations. Breeding the ultimate mutant cat squad and trying to balance their weird genetic traits became an obsession. The dark and sometimes graphic humor and the relentless difficulty might not be for everyone, but for me, it hit the right buttons. The story follows Calvin Rafferty as he searches for a way to save his fiancée, Faye, who has been trapped in a supernatural slumber after a ritual gone wrong. sources.text: The hit RPG Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection , currently available on XBOX Series X|S, will launch on XBOX on PC on November 18 , 2026, with Xbox Play Anywhere support. This will allow players to enjoy the game on XBOX Series X|S, Windows 11 PCs, and compatible handheld gaming devices at no additional cost. Players can pick up right where they left off on their preferred device, with all save data, additional game content, achievements, and more carried over seamlessly. Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is a turn-based RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter, allowing players to enjoy an adventure on a larger scale than ever before. The story follows the prince or princess of Azuria, the only Rathalos Rider in the country, and Eleanor, the princess of Vermeil, each setting out for the forbidden ground with their own hopes and convictions, embark on a journey to uncover the truth of the world. After making an historic discovery, the protagonist, a trained Rider, sets out on a journey to learn more about the various situations unfolding across the world. Players can enjoy a variety of features, including evolving turn-based battles and Habitat Restoration, which allows players to release monsters back into the wild and change their Ecosystem rank. Even after taking your time to enjoy the main story, there is still more to experience. After updating the game to the latest version and loading your cleared save data, you can take on a high-difficulty version of the final boss battle. If you can beat this challenge, Royal versions of nearly all monsters will appear throughout the various areas of the map. In addition, Royal Invasive Monsters and Royal Calamitous Elder Dragons will also appear, offering highly challenging battles. Take on these formidable foes with your well-trained roster of monsters. sources.text: This message was just sent to Team XBOX employees globally. At Town Hall on Tuesday, I talked about the four Cs and the choices we are making to put them into practice. You’ve seen a lot of our work on Core and Content. Today I want to share two leadership appointments supporting Creator and Connection. Kayleen Walters will transition from her role at Mojang to President of XP, a new XBOX division focused on how people experience our franchises beyond the games themselves, and Maria Angelidou-Smith will join XBOX as CEO of Mojang and Minecraft. Both will report to me. Kayleen has spent her career building entertainment franchises. Before XBOX, she spent 13 years at Lucasfilm helping guide Star Wars across films, products, and partnerships. At Minecraft, she helped grow consumer products into a multibillion-dollar business with more than 250 licensees and was Executive Producer of A Minecraft Movie , the biggest film in the U.S. last year and a top-five release worldwide. She is also a producer of the sequel. XP is a play on “Experience Points” and formalizes four investment areas for us: XBOX PICTURES for film and television adaptations; XBOX PRODUCTS for licensing and merchandise; XBOX PARTNERSHIPS for sponsors and brand partners; and XBOX PLACES for our marquee broadcast and in-person events, theme parks, and other location-based experiences. Our franchises can mean more to people than the time they spend playing them, and Kayleen knows how to build those experiences with the industry without losing what made people care about the franchise in the first place. Kayleen’s move also gave us time to think carefully about what Mojang needs in its next leader. Minecraft is one of the largest communities in entertainment. Hundreds of millions of people play, build, create, teach, watch, mod, run servers, and build businesses around Minecraft. The community doesn’t just consume the product. It helps shape what the product becomes. That was central to our search. Mojang already has an exceptional game development team that knows Minecraft and its players deeply. We wanted someone who has built products for communities at enormous scale, who is deeply technical, and who understands how creators, product, technology, and monetization come together. Maria brings a rare combination of those experiences. She spent nearly a decade at Meta, where she led Facebook Groups used by more than 1.8 billion people each month, as well as Events, Creators, Search, Profile, and Monetization. She later led product and technology at Personio and served as Chief Product Officer at Reddit, another of the world’s largest community platforms. She has built products used by billions of people and led product and engineering organizations through significant growth and change. Maria brings deep experience to Mojang, along with a respect for what makes Minecraft special. Her first priority will be learning from the teams and communities who know Minecraft best. She starts Monday, October 19. Please join me in congratulating Kayleen and welcoming Maria to XBOX!
